description: Import an existing private key as the active wallet for its chain. Optionally encrypt and save it to the local keystore by providing a label and password. The wallet is set active immediately.

label.description: Label for saving to keystore (required together with password)

password.description: Password to encrypt and save to keystore (minimum 12 characters)

private_key.description: Raw private key — EVM: hex (with or without 0x), SVM: base58 64-byte keypair

name: printr_wallet_import

saved.description: Whether the wallet was saved to the keystore
